location: Brisbane QLD (Melbourne office at 400 Collins Street)
subject: Graduate Program application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Bornhorst + Ward team,

I'm applying for your Graduate Program, which I found on your careers page.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your page says graduates get real project work and a mentor from day one, which is the kind of start I am looking for after my site years and my design course. My degree is from the Philippines rather than an Australian university, and I am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane or working from your Melbourne office.

Would you be open to a short call about the program? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
